verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only per-key, end-user tooling: SK Manager configures one key's FIDO/PIV/OTP functions, and the FAQ describes a user disabling a lost key and provisioning a replacement on their own account. Nothing documents organization-scale pre-registration, bulk configuration, or tracking of issued keys, so these single-key tools are adjacent rather than fleet provisioning.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can provision keys across an organization at scale — pre-registration, bulk configuration, and lifecycle tracking of issued keys
